metadata.title: Stock futures climb ahead of Micron earnings, PCE data - MarketWatch

content.text:
1 hour ago
Stock futures climb ahead of Micron earnings, PCE data
U.S. stock futures climbed on Wednesday, as U.S. oil prices continued to fall. Investors were awaiting Micron Technology’s earnings due after the bell and the personal consumption expenditures index due Thursday.
S&P 500 futures were up 0.2%.
Dow Jones Industrial Average futures were down 0.1%.
Nasdaq 100 futures were up 0.4%.
